entries.en: Wheiskaet would first like to verify that you are not a complete fraud.
entries.fr: Wheiskaet voudrait vous soumettre à un test pour évaluer vos compétences.
entries.ja: コスタ・デル・ソルのヴェイスケートは、本番の前の肩慣らしをさせたいようだ。
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Before he bothers giving you a truly demanding task, Wheiskaet would first have you attend to a simple one. Place the herring he has given you on an eastern cape near Costa del Sol to lure out the nix that has been seen in the vicinity.

entries.en: You dispatch the slimy creature with great fanfare and sever one of its legs as proof of your kill. Show Wheiskaet that the deed is done.
entries.fr: Vous avez abattu  et récupéré une cuisse bien charnue. Portez-la à Wheiskaet pour lui prouver que vous avez accompli votre mission avec succès.

entries.en: Wheiskaet explains that a recent incident with a former employee has forced him to treat strangers with greater caution. Having proven yourself to be nothing like that other poor, unfortunate soul, he is now willing to give you a challenge as befits your talents.
entries.fr: Wheiskaet pense que vous êtes à la hauteur pour accomplir la mission qu'il vous réserve. Parlez-lui de nouveau pour en savoir plus.
entries.ja: ヴェイスケートは、冒険者の力が偽物ではないとわかってくれた。さぁ、ゲゲルジュの依頼を開始しよう。

entries.en: Master Gegeruju's requests can be more demanding than you realize. Before I set you to your true task, I would like to verify that this won't be a waste of my time.
entries.fr: On va commencer par une tâche très simple pour évaluer tes compétences.
entries.ja:
ゲゲルジュの旦那からの依頼は、簡単なもんじゃない。
本番の前に、肩慣らしと行こうじゃないか。

entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: A nix has recently been seen prowling the beach to the east. As you can imagine, my master does not want large slimy creatures anywhere near his lands.
entries.fr: Il y a  affamé qui dévore tous les poissons qui ont le malheur de s'approcher trop près, surtout les plus gros, ce qui a le don d'agacer le seigneur Gegeruju.
entries.ja:
最近、西から流れてきたが、
海辺の魚を食い荒らして、旦那が気になさっている。

食らいついたを倒してこい。

entries.en: Slay the nix and return to me. Oh, and don't forget to bring me a leg as proof of the kill.
entries.fr: Et comme je ne sais pas encore si tu es un mme de confiance, je vais te demander de me rapporter une de ses cuisses pour me prouver que tu as bien fait ton travail. Va !
entries.ja:
そうだな……お前が倒した証拠に、
でも、持ってきてもらおうか。

entries.en: Lest you think me overly cautious for testing you in this way, you should know that we had an incident not long ago. A foolish young employee was dismissed for lying about his past. He claimed to have served in the Company of Heroes, but I knew for a fact he did not.
entries.fr: Tu te débrouilles pas mal, la bleusaille.
entries.ja:
……なるほどな。
お前の「力」が偽物でないことはよくわかった。
entries.jaMacro:

entries.en: Anyway, now that the pointless busywork is finished, I shall give you a challenge as befits your talents.
entries.fr: Maintenant, on va corser un peu l'affaire.

今みたいな簡単な仕事とは、わけが違うぞ。
……チビって逃げるなよ？
